reviews.comment:
Lleve miles de veces mi auto y siempre tenia arreglos muy caros, nunca me daban los repuestos ni sabian explicarme que tenia, hasta tenia que pagar por las pruebas,  cuando lo llevo a otro taller la averia no tenia NADA QUE VER con lo presupuestado por el aca. Una lastima que ensucien asi esta institicion de años con un servicio tan malo.

(Translated by Google)
I took my car there thousands of times and it always ended up costing me a fortune. They never gave me the parts I needed, and they couldn't even explain what was wrong with it. I even had to pay for the diagnostic tests. When I took it to another shop, the problem had NOTHING TO DO with the estimate they'd given me here. It's a shame they're tarnishing this long-established institution with such terrible service.
